num_sources: <int> Number of sources in the logistics network.
num_sinks: <int> Number of sinks in the logistics network.
B: <int> Upper bound on individual supply and demand values.
delta: <float> Ratio controlling the proportion of per-unit transportation cost relative to fixed cost.
total_supply: <int> Total supply across all sources, which equals total demand across all sinks.
supply: <list[int], length num_sources> Quantity of goods available at each source that must be shipped out entirely.
demand: <list[int], length num_sinks> Quantity of goods required at each sink that must be satisfied exactly.
fixed_cost: <list[list[int]], shape [num_sources][num_sinks]> Fixed cost charged for using the route from each source to each sink, incurred whenever any goods are shipped along that route.
variable_cost: <list[list[float]], shape [num_sources][num_sinks]> Per-unit transportation cost for shipping goods along the route from each source to each sink.
capacity: <list[list[int]], shape [num_sources][num_sinks]> Maximum quantity of goods that can be shipped along the route from each source to each sink.
